page.notes: The right edge strip (gen, con, pra, ... ) is the neighbouring page and was left out. Greek words were copied as printed; "Θεάνθρω-πος" is broken at the line end and the second half "πος" was read from the scan with some doubt. The italic/roman split of the conclusion list follows the visible type; the Keckerm. citation is set in roman inside the paragraph. The word "genus." at bottom right is treated as a catchword.
